additionalRules: An Iron Hills Army must include Dain Ironfoot, who is always the Army's General.

specialRules.name: "Ironfoot has come!"
specialRules.text: In Scenarios where you roll for Warbands to arrive, or ones where you roll to see which part of the board you deploy a Warband in (though not when rolling to choose deployment zones), you may modify the roll for Warbands from this Army by +1 or -1.

specialRules.name: Yanâd Durinul
specialRules.text: Friendly Infantry models may re-roll To Wound Rolls of a natural 1 when making Strikes, so long as they are in base contact with 2 or more friendly Infantry models.

specialRules.name: Long March from the Iron Hills
specialRules.text: Friendly models gain the Mountain Dweller special rule.

specialRules.name: "I've always found Thorin the more reasonable of the two..."
specialRules.text: Dain gains the Master of Battle (5+) special rule.

units.name: Dain Ironfoot, Lord of the Iron Hills
units.keywords: DWARF, IRON HILLS, INFANTRY, HERO, UNIQUE

specialRules.name: Lord of the Iron Hills
specialRules.text: Friendly Iron Hills models within 12" of Dáin automatically pass all Courage Tests they are required to take.

specialRules.name: Fiery Temper
specialRules.text: After Dáin has killed an enemy model, then from that point onwards whenever Dáin Moves, he must always Charge an enemy model if possible.

specialRules.name: Fearsome Charge
specialRules.text: If Dáin Charges into Combat, then until the end of turn he counts as having the Terror special rule.

specialRules.name: Headbutt
specialRules.text: If Dáin wins a Duel Roll but fails to slay every enemy model involved in the Combat, he may choose a single enemy model on a 25mm base involved in the Combat and roll a D6. On a 5+, the chosen model is immediately knocked Prone.

specialRules.name: Dwarven Lords
specialRules.text: A Dwarf King will always have the Faction Keyword of the most common type of Dwarf model in the same Army, and gains a special rule based on it: Erebor - Ancient Enemies (Orc); Iron Hills - Fearless; Khazad-dûm - throwing weapons.

units.name: Drar
units.keywords: DWARF, IRON HILLS, INFANTRY, HERO, UNIQUE

units.name: Iron Hills Captain
options: Exchange Shield and Spear for Mattock - Free

specialRules.name: Mattock
specialRules.text: This is a two-handed weapon. Additionally, if a model wielding a Mattock wins a Duel Roll they may choose to try to knock down an enemy model instead of making Strikes.

units.name: Murin
units.keywords: DWARF, IRON HILLS, INFANTRY, HERO, UNIQUE

specialRules.name: Kalazal
specialRules.text: This is a Unique hand weapon. Murin gains a bonus of +1 To Wound when making Strikes against Orc, Goblin or Uruk-hai models.

specialRules.name: Rapid-fire Bolt Thrower
specialRules.text: This is a crossbow that fires D6 shots per turn rather than just one, with a 45° field of fire to either side. An Iron Hills Chariot may still shoot even if it has Moved or is Engaged in Combat, and never suffers the -1 penalty for Moving and Shooting.

specialRules.name: Chariot Charge
specialRules.text: When an Iron Hills Chariot Moves via Chariot Charge, it will inflict 3 Strength 6 Impact Hits.

specialRules.name: Dwarven Crew
specialRules.text: Any Iron Hills Warrior that ends their Activation in base contact with an Iron Hills Chariot may join its crew. If it does, remove the Iron Hills Warrior from the board as a Casualty. The Iron Hills Chariot then immediately regains a single Wound lost earlier in the battle.

units.name: Iron Hills Goat Rider
options: Exchange War Spear for Mattock - Free

specialRules.name: War Goat
specialRules.text: GOAT | MOUNT — Mv8" Fv2 Sv6+ S4 D5 A0 W1 C7+ I7+. Mountain Dweller. Devastating Charge ACTIVE: when this model Charges against one or more 25mm models, roll a D6 for each; on a 5+ that model is immediately knocked Prone.

specialRules.name: Mattock
specialRules.text: This is a two-handed weapon. Additionally, if a model wielding a Mattock wins a Duel Roll they may choose to try to knock down an enemy model instead of making Strikes.

units.name: Iron Hills Ballista
wargear: Crewed by four Iron Hills Siege Crew (Mv5" Fv4 Sv4+ S4 D6 A1 W1 C6+ I6+, Heavy Armour, Hand Weapon), one of which is the Siege Veteran

specialRules.name: Area Effect
specialRules.text: After rolling To Hit against the actual target, if the actual target was a Battlefield Target then all other models within 2" of the actual target suffer a Strength 5 hit and, if they survive, will be knocked Prone.

specialRules.name: Accurate
specialRules.text: An Iron Hills Ballista will only Scatter 3" rather than 6".

specialRules.name: The Old Twirly Whirlies
specialRules.text: An Iron Hills Ballista always counts as declaring a Heroic Shoot each Shoot Phase for free. When it hits a target, a line is drawn from the Ballista to the marker under the target; shooting attacks of Strength 6 or lower cannot cross or target within 3" of that line, and Strength 7+ attacks that do so are cancelled on a D6 roll of 5+.

sourceNotes: Roster, points, and army-wide rules from the prancingponypub The Iron Hills army-list page. Full stat blocks, wargear, and special-rule text from the Dwarven Holds faction page on the same site; Drar and Murin cross-referenced from the Good Legacy faction page (also on the same site).
